programmes.d: Newlyweds Brandon and Brandy Wiley are on a backpacking adventure in Costa Rica.
An 18 year-old elk hunter in Montana is seriously injured by a bear.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Why Am I Blue?

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: I Need Some Help Here
programmes.d: A woman complaining of abdominal pain finds out that she is in fact pregnant.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Campstove Stuffing
programmes.d: A six-year old boy suffers a life-threatening stroke; a man has a camp stove stuck on his penis; a young ER doctor is under the gun when he is asked to assess the health of another doctor's wife.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Code Black
programmes.d: The force of a tornado drove a fence picket through Julie's neck. With it blocking her airways, the only way of saving her is to pull it out.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Life & Limb Too
programmes.d: A pregnant woman's leg pain turns out to be a flesh-eating virus, threatening life and limb. A Desert Storm war veteran swallows razor blades on a dare, and a bride-to-be spends her wedding day in the ER after collapsing at the altar.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: I Can't Remember
programmes.d: A patient can't remember the past 20 years, but in order to treat her, her doctor desperately needs to know what she's forgotten. After reviving his cardiac arrest victim, a doctor packs him in ice, hoping to preserve his brain function.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: We Have A Heartbeat
